# Gomes's Construction Inc.

> Owner-led roofing and siding contractor in Brockton, Massachusetts. Installs complete CertainTeed roofing systems backed by a 40-year material warranty (issued by the manufacturer) and a 10-year labor guarantee, and handles insurance claims for storm damage. Serves homeowners within about 60 miles of Brockton. Free estimates, usually a same-day callback.

## Business facts

- Legal name: Gomes's Construction Inc.

- Licenses: Massachusetts Home Improvement Contractor 201976; Massachusetts Construction Supervisor CS-115736
- Certifications: CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, CertainTeed Shingle Quality Specialist, CertainTeed Silver Star (vinyl and polymer siding)
- Reputation: 5.0 stars from 89 Google reviews
- Experience: more than 12 years

## Services

- Roof installation and replacement
- Roof repair and maintenance
- Siding installation
- Insurance claims restoration (storm damage)
- Gutters
- Skylights
- Roof inspections

## The roofing system

Every roof is installed as one single-brand CertainTeed system, never mixed materials, so it is covered as one system:

1. Solid deck: plywood CDX; soft or rotted decking is replaced first
2. Ice and water shield: CertainTeed WinterGuard at the roof edges, where New England ice dams start
3. Synthetic underlayment: CertainTeed RoofRunner across the whole deck
4. Starter strip: CertainTeed SwiftStart at the eaves against wind uplift
5. Architectural shingles: CertainTeed Landmark PRO
6. Ridge cap: CertainTeed Shadow Ridge

## How it works

1. Request a quote by phone or with the form on the website
2. Expert inspection of the property, usually the same day or the next day
3. Clean installation, with the job site cleaned up at the end

Prices are only given after an in-person inspection, in a written estimate. Work starts after a written contract is signed.
